text.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening consecutive particle that resumes the scene and binds the temporal frame to the resulting action
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) does not merely add another event. Joined to the temporal frame, it restarts the shirt narrative after the accusation of 12:95 and compresses arrival, casting, and restored sight into one consequence-chain. Its turning-point feel matches other Surah 12 climax frames (12:18, 12:35, 12:77), so the charge is answered by event sequence rather than by argument.

topics.headline: resumed temporal consequence-chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse resumes the suspended shirt action after 12:95 and lets the event itself answer the accusation.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence reads the temporal opening as linked to the main casting event, and the CRITICAL rows coherently describe a resumptive consequence frame.

topics.headline: turning-point formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the opening as part of Surah 12's climactic turning-point syntax, not as a flat connective.
topics.reason: The row gives concrete Surah 12 parallels and does not override the local parse.

words.gloss_range: punctual temporal particle marking the arrival as the trigger for the answer-clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَمَّا}} ({{tr:lammā}}) makes the herald's arrival the exact trigger, not loose background time. Its frame holds the moment of arrival until the answer-clause releases the casting and restoration. In Surah 12's climax pattern, this timing closes the suspense created by the earlier shirt command and the intervening accusation.

topics.headline: arrival as exact trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that restoration begins at the precise arrival moment, not after an undefined interval.
topics.reason: The temporal clause is syntactically forced as the setting for the main casting event.

topics.headline: final narrative climax marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this timing formula marks Jacob's vindication as the last major reversal of the surah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify the formula as a Surah 12 peak while preserving the local temporal grammar.

words.gloss_range: extra/pleonastic temporal-frame particle that marks the arrival without adding an object clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) is not introducing a new content clause here. It sits inside the temporal frame, preserving the completed-arrival force while making that frame feel formally marked. The reader hears the single arrival-event held in suspense before the rapid answer unfolds.

topics.headline: pleonastic marker of the temporal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small particle heightens the arrival frame without creating a separate proposition.
topics.reason: The following verb is perfective and the attachment evidence treats the whole phrase as the temporal setting.

words.gloss_range: completed directed arrival that triggers the consequent shirt-action
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing/coming to a scene; locally the simple Form I perfect marks completed arrival
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَ}} ({{tr:jāʾa}}) foregrounds completed arrival before the herald is named. That plain arrival is event-generating: it brings Yusuf's sign into Jacob's scene and starts the chain of casting, face-contact, sight, and speech. It also reverses earlier arrival scenes in Surah 12: the false shirt arrival of 12:18 and the brothers' recognition-arc arrival of 12:58 are answered by restorative arrival here.

topics.headline: completed arrival before consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices arrival itself as the trigger that activates the rest of the verse's action chain.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and explicit following subject create the temporal condition for the main event.

topics.headline: arrival completes the shirt dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the motion implied by Yusuf's command in 12:93 reaches its endpoint here.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the local arrival to the earlier shirt-command sequence without changing the local verb sense.

topics.headline: arrival scenes reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earlier arrivals associated with concealment and testing are answered by this restorative arrival.
topics.reason: The rows name concrete Surah 12 arrivals, including 12:18 and 12:58, and the local scene supports the reversal.

words.gloss_range: the definite glad-news bearer, a role-title for the person carrying Yusuf's sign
words.root_gloss_range: glad tidings, human/embodied surface, and related skin-contact associations; locally the herald role is selected, with embodied contact pressure active through the shirt-on-face scene
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَشِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-bashīru}}) is treated as a known role, not as a named individual. The definite role-title carries Yusuf's sign into the scene, and the root's glad-tidings field becomes bodily when the shirt reaches Jacob's face. The glad-news cry over the found Yusuf in 12:19 returns as a herald who brings Yusuf's sign back to the family. The local sound movement from {{ar:ٱلْبَشِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-bashīru}}) to {{ar:بَصِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:baṣīran}}) makes news become sight through contact, not through announcement alone.

topics.headline: definite herald role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the person is presented by function: the known bearer of the shirt-sign, not an individually named brother.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, nominative, and subject of the arrival verb; the form supports a role-title reading.

topics.headline: glad news realized through surface contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the good news is not only spoken; it is realized through a shirt touching Jacob's face.
topics.reason: The local noun still means herald, while the face-contact scene licenses embodied b-sh-r pressure without replacing the selected role sense.

topics.headline: glad-news arc returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the b-sh-r arc moving from the glad-news cry over Yusuf in 12:19 to the herald who returns Yusuf's sign in 12:96.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references and the local role-title coherently closes the glad-news pattern.

topics.headline: herald-to-sighted sound movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the near-sound pair between the herald and the sighted result, with face-contact explaining why the sound echo matters.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the herald before the contact action and the sighted state after it, making the sound echo causally legible.

words.gloss_range: causative directed casting/placing of the shirt onto the face, with the attached object retrieved from 12:93
words.root_gloss_range: meeting/encounter and casting/placing by derivation; locally Form IV selects caused directed contact rather than mutual meeting
words.prose: {{ar:أَلْقَىٰهُ}} ({{tr:alqāhu}}) is the hinge action. Its attached pronoun keeps the shirt from 12:93 active across the intervening accusation, while Form IV makes the herald cause the shirt to meet Jacob's face. The action fulfills Yusuf's earlier command and reverses harmful casting in 12:10 into restorative contact.

topics.headline: shirt object retrieved by suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is not vague: the suffix carries the shirt from 12:93 into this verse.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the suffix as direct object, and the CRITICAL rows identify the antecedent as the earlier shirt.

topics.headline: caused encounter through placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the action as deliberate surface application, a caused meeting between shirt and face.
topics.reason: The local Form IV and following surface prepositional phrase select directed casting/placing while preserving encounter pressure as the caused contact.

topics.headline: plural command executed by singular act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Yusuf's 12:93 command becoming a completed singular action in 12:96.
topics.reason: The repeated casting phrase with the same object and face-target supports command-fulfillment.

topics.headline: harmful casting reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root-field of casting move from harm in 12:10 to restoration in 12:96.
topics.reason: The concrete references name opposite outcomes within the same Surah 12 casting field.

words.gloss_range: surface-contact preposition linking the cast object to Jacob's face
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the physical interface of the miracle. It marks the shirt as placed upon the face, not merely sent toward Jacob. The preposition turns object movement into effective contact, so the following restoration is grammatically linked to surface placement.

topics.headline: upon-ness as causal interface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shirt works through contact on the face, not by mere arrival or possession.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the face as the placement complement of the casting verb.

words.gloss_range: Jacob's own face as the possessed surface where sight-restoration occurs
words.root_gloss_range: face, outward surface, direction, and orientation; locally the concrete possessed face is selected, with orientation and perception pressure
words.prose: {{ar:وَجْهِهِۦ}} ({{tr:wajhihī}}) localizes the sign on Jacob's own face. The face is both outward surface and perception site, so the shirt reaches the place where identity, attention, and sight converge. The phrase also fulfills the earlier command about the father's face in 12:93, now narrated as the reached target. The father's face sought as exclusive attention in 12:9 becomes the site of restored perception in 12:96.

topics.headline: Jacob's own face localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the restoration as personal and bodily, pinned to Jacob's own face rather than to a generic surface.
topics.reason: The noun is singular, genitive under the preposition, and carries Jacob's possessive suffix.

topics.headline: face as surface and sight-site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the face is not incidental anatomy; it is the outward sensory interface where sight returns.
topics.reason: The local construction selects concrete face while allowing orientation/perception pressure from the root field.

topics.headline: same face-target as 12:93
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact target of Yusuf's 12:93 command reached in 12:96.
topics.reason: The phrase repeats the same preposition-plus-face target with a perspective shift from kinship phrase to pronoun.

topics.headline: father's face from attention to restoration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the father's face moving from contested attention in 12:9 to restored perception in 12:96.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows provide concrete references and a coherent Surah 12 face motif.

words.gloss_range: consecutive/result particle marking immediate restoration after contact
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks zero-delay consequence: contact is followed by restored sight. Together with the opening particle, it brackets the scene as compressed movement from arrival to result.

topics.headline: instant result after contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse presents restoration as the direct consequence of the shirt touching the face.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the result clause after the casting clause.

topics.headline: two particles bracket the scene

topics.reason: The first particle opens the temporal frame and the second introduces the result clause.

words.gloss_range: completed reversion into restored sight, with the subject undergoing return of state
words.root_gloss_range: returning, reverting, repelling, or turning back; locally Form VIII selects positive reversion/restoration of Jacob's sighted state
words.prose: {{ar:ٱرْتَدَّ}} ({{tr:irtadda}}) presents sight as a state returning, not as a new faculty simply handed over. The Form VIII internalizes the reversal in Jacob's condition, and the following state-word names what he returns into. The same return field can be negative elsewhere, but here it is restorative: blindness is treated as the interruption and sight as the recovered condition. Yusuf's promised sighted outcome in 12:93 is fulfilled as recovery, and the surah's returned-goods motif in 12:65 widens into a returned faculty.

topics.headline: reversion into a named state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar frames restored sight as return into a state, not merely as an external repair.
topics.reason: The verb is Form VIII perfect and the following accusative state supplies the result condition.

topics.headline: return-root made restorative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's turning-back pressure is positive here: blindness is turned back and sight returns.
topics.reason: The local complement selects sensory restoration, so negative reversion parallels serve as contrast rather than controlling the local valence.

topics.headline: 12:93 prediction fulfilled as return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf's predicted sighted outcome in 12:93 is fulfilled with a return verb, making the miracle recovery rather than mere acquisition.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete prediction-fulfillment link and the local wording supplies a return verb.

topics.headline: return motif tightened
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the restoration motif widening from returned goods to returned faculty, with the verb's doubled stop matching the compressed reversal.
topics.reason: The motif rows name concrete Surah 12 parallels and the sound observation supports the local compressed action.

words.gloss_range: sighted as Jacob's restored circumstantial state, with physical sight foregrounded and insight discourse nearby
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, sight, perception, and insight; locally physical sightedness is selected, with epistemic resonance from the following knowledge claim
words.prose: {{ar:بَصِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:baṣīran}}) names the state in which Jacob's return is realized: he reverts as sighted. The adjective marks restored faculty and condition, not just an isolated act of seeing, and it answers the sighted outcome forecast in 12:93. Because Jacob immediately recalls his God-sourced knowledge claim, physical sight and vindicated knowing meet without collapsing into the same thing. The wider sight/insight register remains pressure through 12:108 and divine seeing language such as 17:96, while the local sense stays Jacob's restored human sight. The sound nearness to {{ar:ٱلْبَشِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-bashīru}}) makes the news-bearer and the sighted result audible as one scene.

topics.headline: sighted as arrived-at state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word gives Jacob's restored condition, not a second action after the return.
topics.reason: The adjective is accusative and functions as the circumstantial state after the return verb.

topics.headline: physical sight beside knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that restored eyesight becomes public evidence beside Jacob's claim of knowledge from God.
topics.reason: The local sense is physical sight, while the immediate speech context licenses epistemic resonance.

topics.headline: predicted sighted state fulfilled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same sighted outcome promised in 12:93 appearing as the realized state in 12:96.
topics.reason: The rows give a direct prediction-fulfillment echo with the same result word.

topics.headline: news-bearer to sighted result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local sound bracket: the herald's title and Jacob's sighted state are near enough to make the transformation audible.
topics.reason: The pair stands in the same event sequence with the contact action between agent and result.

topics.headline: broader sight register

topics.reason: The divine-attribute parallels and insight links are valid as register pressure, but local grammar selects Jacob's restored human sight.

words.gloss_range: he said; restored Jacob's direct speech introducing vindication
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, statement; locally a perfect speech verb introducing the quoted rhetorical recall
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) turns restored sight into interpreted proof. The subject is supplied by the restored Jacob, so the one accused in 12:95 now becomes the speaker who explains the event. The speech verb also reverses earlier shirt-and-speech scenes: after false shirt speech in 12:18, this speech follows the true shirt-sign. Jacob's patient speech in 12:83 and his source-knowledge claim in 12:86 now reappear as vindication rather than endurance.

topics.headline: restored Jacob speaks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the restored seer immediately becoming the authoritative speaker.
topics.reason: The discourse supplies Jacob as subject and the following quote is his vindicating speech.

topics.headline: arrival-shirt-speech reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speech verb moving from deceptive or patient registers to public vindication.
topics.reason: The rows name concrete Surah 12 speech scenes and the local quote confirms the vindication function.

topics.headline: accused becomes interpreter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the register shift from Jacob as accused object to Jacob as the speaker who evaluates their knowledge.
topics.reason: The boundary from 12:95 to 12:96 shifts from accusation against Jacob to Jacob's first-person speech.

words.gloss_range: interrogative plus negation governing a jussive verb as rhetorical recall
words.prose: {{ar:أَلَمْ}} ({{tr:a-lam}}) is a negative question that expects acknowledgment, not information. After sight has returned, it forces the addressees to remember Jacob's earlier claim in 12:86 and the search-instruction arc of 12:87. The grammar turns their 12:95 confidence into a compelled admission.

topics.headline: negative question as proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the question as a vindicating speech-act: it recalls what Jacob had already said.
topics.reason: The particle governs the jussive recall verb and opens a question whose expected answer is affirmative.

topics.headline: accusation reversed into admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earlier accusation of 12:95 overturned by a question whose answer the audience must concede.
topics.reason: The boundary rows tie the question directly to the prior accusation and to recoverable earlier sayings.

words.gloss_range: first-person jussive of saying inside the rhetorical recall, governing addressees and remembered content
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, statement; locally the jussive first-person form recalls Jacob's earlier statement
words.prose: {{ar:أَقُلْ}} ({{tr:aqul}}) is the clipped jussive form of the saying verb after the negative question. It governs both the addressees and the following content clause, so the recall is precise: Jacob is not merely saying that he spoke, but identifying what he had said. That makes his earlier speech in 12:86 and 12:87 evidence after the sign arrives, while the prophetic comparison with 11:31 keeps the claim God-sourced rather than autonomous unseen-knowledge. The local grammar also corrects the tag anomaly in the input: the word is from the saying root, not a smallness adjective.

topics.headline: jussive recall verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compressed jussive form as the engine of Jacob's retrospective challenge.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the preceding negative question and takes the addressee phrase plus content clause.

topics.headline: local grammar overrides tag anomaly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local form must be read as a saying verb despite the anomalous tag evidence.
topics.reason: The aligned QAC row and local syntax support first-person jussive of q-w-l.

topics.headline: recalled speech becomes evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Jacob's earlier speech becoming evidence once the visible sign has arrived.
topics.reason: The rows connect the local saying verb to prior and comparative prophetic speech without changing the local morphology.

words.gloss_range: to you; addressee phrase pointing the recalled speech at the doubting plural audience
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) aims the vindication at the plural audience who had doubted Jacob. The restored sight is not left as private relief; the speech is directed back to the same group whose accusation in 12:95 is now exposed.

topics.headline: proof addressed to the doubters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob's proof is pointed at a plural audience, not spoken into the air.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase attaches to the saying verb and carries a second-person plural suffix.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person particle-plus-pronoun opening the recalled knowledge claim
words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّىٓ}} ({{tr:innī}}) opens the remembered content with emphatic first-person force. It scopes over the whole knowledge contrast, not only the next verb. The variant with fuller final vowel changes sound texture but not the claim: Jacob's assertion remains emphatic, personal, and now publicly verified. Its first-person emphasis answers the emphatic accusation against Jacob in 12:95 with Jacob's own verified knowledge claim in 12:96.

topics.headline: emphatic first-person content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob's recalled claim is asserted with emphatic first-person grammar over the whole knowledge contrast.
topics.reason: The particle begins the embedded content clause and governs the following predicate.

topics.headline: variant changes sound, not meaning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational texture difference while the semantics of the knowledge claim stay stable.
topics.reason: The accepted variant affects the final vowel/yāʾ realization but not the syntax or meaning of the claim.

topics.headline: first-person assertion reverses accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the emphatic register move from accusation against Jacob in 12:95 to Jacob's own knowledge assertion in 12:96.
topics.reason: The boundary comparison is concrete and matches the shift into first-person speech.

words.gloss_range: I know as an ongoing God-sourced knowledge claim, with source and object grammatically separated
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, knowledge, teaching, signs/marks in related fields; locally Form I imperfect selects Jacob's knowing, while source-marking keeps it received from God
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) is not a bare claim that Jacob was right once. As an imperfect verb with a source phrase and a relative object, it states an ongoing knowledge-state received from God. The physical shirt-sign verifies the claim without reducing knowledge to eyesight. The same source-knowledge formula from 12:86 returns after restoration as public vindication. The same root then returns in the final verb, making the close of the ayah an antithesis: Jacob knows from God; the addressed group does not.

topics.headline: ongoing knowledge with source and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Jacob's claim as ongoing God-sourced knowledge, not a one-time correct guess.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect and takes both source phrase and object clause in the local syntax.

topics.headline: knowledge verified by sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shirt as a visible sign verifying knowledge, while Jacob remains the knower rather than the teacher.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form I knowing; sign and teaching fields survive as pressure because the scene visibly verifies received knowledge.

topics.headline: earlier formula returns as public proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Jacob's 12:86 source-knowledge formula returning after restoration as public vindication.
topics.reason: The rows quote the earlier formula and the local speech frames it as recalled proof.

topics.headline: I know versus you do not know
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root split into opposed roles: Jacob's singular knowing against the group's negated knowing.
topics.reason: The final relative clause repeats the same root under negation, creating the local antithesis.

words.gloss_range: source-marking preposition linking Jacob's knowledge to God before the known content is named
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the preposition that makes the knowledge sourced, not comparative. It attaches to the knowledge verb and governs the divine name before the object clause appears. The ordering foregrounds where Jacob's knowledge comes from before what the others fail to know.

topics.headline: source preposition for knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob claims received knowledge from God, not superior comparison with God.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as source complement while the following relative clause supplies the object.

topics.headline: source foregrounded before content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decisive issue is the source of knowledge before the content of knowledge is itemized.
topics.reason: The phrase precedes the relative object and the boundary rows show the source phrase answering the delusion charge.

words.gloss_range: the divine name governed by the source preposition as the source of Jacob's knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: the proper divine name in the worship/deity field, with contested bewilderment derivation as secondary pressure; locally the absolute divine name is selected as source
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is governed by the source preposition, so the divine name is not a loose theological aside. Jacob's knowledge is sourced from the absolute divine name rather than a merely relational title. The disputed bewilderment pressure remains secondary: the family confusion is answered by knowledge from the God whose name they had invoked. The narrator's report of Jacob's God-taught knowledge in 12:68 becomes Jacob's own source claim in 12:96, and the divine name used in the sons' oath-backed accusation in 12:95 is reclaimed as the source of his vindication.

topics.headline: divine name as source complement

topics.reason: The divine name is genitive under the source preposition attached to the knowledge verb.

topics.headline: absolute divine name, not class-term

topics.reason: The local surface is the proper divine name; derivational dispute survives as pressure but does not replace the source-name reading.

topics.headline: divine teaching becomes spoken source claim

topics.reason: The rows cite concrete Surah 12 knowledge-teaching passages and the local phrase makes God the source.

words.gloss_range: headless relative object of the knowledge verb, leaving the known content unspecified

topics.reason: The relative clause completes the knowledge verb by contrast with the negated audience verb.

words.gloss_range: negation particle turning the audience's imperfect verb into ongoing not-knowing
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is the hinge that turns repeated knowledge language into antithesis. It negates the imperfect verb as an ongoing state, so the audience's ignorance is not merely a past mistake before the shirt arrived. The small particle marks the boundary between Jacob's access and their lack of it.

topics.headline: ongoing not-knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sons' ignorance as a present state, not merely a historical error.
topics.reason: The particle negates the following imperfect verb in the relative clause.

topics.headline: negation as knowledge boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the particle as the grammatical wall between Jacob's knowing and the audience's not-knowing.
topics.reason: The negation sits between the same knowledge-root roles and creates the visible antithesis.

words.gloss_range: you know, negated as the addressed plural's ongoing lack of the knowledge Jacob claims from God
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, knowledge, and certifying awareness; locally the Form I imperfect plural is negated to mark the audience's knowledge-limit
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿlamūna}}) completes the ayah by returning to the knowledge root in the opposite role. The verb is plural and negated, so the group that accused Jacob is now named as the ones who do not know. Its shared form family with Jacob's first-person verb makes the contrast personal and grammatical: one speaker knows from God; the addressed group lacks that access. The know-what-you-do-not formula recalls 2:30, while Surah 12's human-not-knowing pattern in 12:21 and Jacob's 12:86 claim culminate on the sons here.

topics.headline: plural audience in ongoing ignorance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees as a plural group whose ignorance is current and collective.
topics.reason: The verb is second-person masculine plural imperfect and is negated by the preceding particle.

topics.headline: knowledge denied in same root field

topics.reason: The same Form I knowledge-root family appears in both verbs, but person and polarity split the roles.

topics.headline: not-knowing formula culminates

topics.reason: The rows give concrete references including 2:30, 12:21, and 12:86 while the local source phrase keeps Jacob's knowledge derivative.

topics.headline: knowledge root closes the ayah

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 5-9 moves from casting, to the face, to return, to seeing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A transferred object reaches the exposed facial interface and the affected faculty returns to its prior operative state. The syntax therefore presents restoration as a contact relay rather than as an unsegmented marvel.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the deliberate transfer that initiates the relay.
The exposed front of the person supplies the receiving interface.
Return to an earlier state defines the change as restoration rather than first acquisition.
Ocular perception identifies the faculty restored at the relay's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: A messenger arrives, an object is applied, and sight is recovered.
changed_reading.after: The ayah articulates a four-stage restorative relay: transfer, facial contact, return to a prior condition, and renewed visual operation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The bearer of good news at word 4 is immediately followed by an event on the face and a return of sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger's root joins glad information to an opening or brightening of the human surface. With the face as the site of contact, good news becomes somatically effective: what is announced is also registered in appearance and perception.

activation_trace.role: Joy-bearing news contributes an affective opening of the visible human surface.
The surface sense makes the messenger's title materially resonate with the face.
The face localizes the news-induced change on the person's visible front.
Restored seeing turns affective opening into an observable bodily result.

changed_reading.before: The title merely identifies the courier as someone carrying favorable information.
changed_reading.after: The bearer embodies the news: arrival opens the human surface and culminates in renewed perception, so message and bodily effect coincide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bodily seeing at word 9 is followed by a spoken contrast between what the speaker knows and what the addressees do not know.
baseline_models.mechanism: The eye and heart branches of sight coexist. The return of ocular capacity publicly externalizes an already held inward discernment, and the repeated saying makes that asymmetry answerable in the social field.

activation_trace.role: Eye-sight supplies the publicly observable recovery.
Heart-sight supplies the inward discernment doubled by the bodily recovery.
Audible speech moves private discernment into a contestable public claim.
Knowledge as disclosure establishes the asymmetry between speaker and addressees.

changed_reading.before: The cure and the ensuing claim to knowledge are two consecutive facts.
changed_reading.after: The bodily cure is public evidence for a prior inward sight: recovered vision stages the vindication of knowledge that had not been shared.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The messenger, restored sight, and the knowledge contrast form one tightly ordered event.
baseline_models.mechanism: A preliminary indication arrives and becomes a distinguishing mark by which hidden knowledge can be recognized. The cure does not merely follow the claim chronologically; it gives that claim a visible guidepost.

activation_trace.role: An advance indication makes the messenger the first visible edge of a larger completion.
Arrival-with-something supplies the vehicle by which the indication becomes present.
A distinguishing sign converts the event into a guide toward what the speaker knows.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply asserts superior knowledge after the recovery.
changed_reading.after: The arrival and recovery function as a visible marker that lets previously hidden knowledge become recognizable without exhausting its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perception is already active before the messenger arrives: departure releases a remote trace, scent is apprehended, and sight later returns. The focus recovery is therefore the public completion of a cross-sensory recognition rather than the first breach in total unawareness.

activation_trace.role: Restoration supplies the culminating return of a faculty.
Vision supplies the final, publicly testable sensory mode.
Departure from a place starts the remote-to-near movement before the focus arrival.
Finding or hitting upon something supplies genuine apprehension before visual recovery.
Odor and smelling provide the advance sensory channel that sight later confirms.

structural_cues: 12:94 immediately precedes the accusation and focus event, placing sensed odor before restored vision.
The sequence runs departure, remote apprehension, contested claim, messenger arrival, and visible recovery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caravan departure, apprehended scent, and the next recovery of sight; I infer a smell-to-sight relay in which the first sense anticipates and the second confirms, while the scent could instead remain an independent intuition.

changed_reading.before: Contact at the messenger's arrival abruptly changes a non-perceiving person into a perceiving one.
changed_reading.after: The contact completes an already active recognition: scent crosses distance first, while returned sight converts private apprehension into shared evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding social verdict classifies the father's perception as longstanding deviation. Recovery then reverses the evaluative direction: the allegedly obsolete error becomes demonstrated knowledge, and those who diagnosed him become the unknowing addressees.

activation_trace.role: The repeated spoken reminder publicly answers the prior social judgment.
Disclosed knowledge supplies the positive category that replaces the accusation.
Deviation from right direction supplies the hostile diagnosis that the focus event overturns.
Long duration hardens the accusation into an entrenched social reading.

structural_cues: 12:95 is direct speech from the same addressee group answered by the focus speaker.
The focus rhetorical question reverses the immediately prior classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an accusation of old deviation followed by recovery and a knowledge contrast; I infer that the event adjudicates between competing readings, while the rhetorical question may also function as a simple reminder without a formal verdict.

changed_reading.before: The final question is an understandable 'I told you so' after recovery.
changed_reading.after: It is a reversal of epistemic authority: a socially entrenched diagnosis of error is exposed as the addressees' failure to know.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus speech does not close the scene in triumph. Its first contextual result is that the addressees rename their conduct as fault and ask for protective forgiveness, turning vindication into the opening of relational repair.

activation_trace.role: The public utterance supplies the pivot from corrected perception to response.
Glad news keeps the corrective speech within a restorative rather than punitive scene.
Protective covering of wrongdoing supplies the requested form of repair.
Wrongdoing supplies the addressees' revised account of their own past.
Missing the right course names their epistemic and moral misalignment.

structural_cues: The addressees' first speech after 12:96 is a request for forgiveness.
Their response changes from diagnosing the father in 12:95 to diagnosing themselves in 12:97.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the corrected claim and the immediate confession; I infer that public vindication enables self-revision and repair, while the confession could be narratively adjacent without being caused by the father's words alone.

changed_reading.before: The father's statement ends the dispute by proving that he was right.
changed_reading.after: His vindication opens a repair sequence: corrected seeing produces corrected self-description in the former accusers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local return of sight initiates returns at larger scales: separated persons enter and are gathered into shelter, an old vision reaches its outcome, and the family is brought from afar. The focus recovery becomes the first compact realization of a reunion-and-fulfillment pattern.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior condition supplies the local restorative template.
Entry moves the dispersed family across the boundary into a shared interior.
Joining a gathering shelter supplies the relational completion of bodily return.
Movement to an eventual outcome makes the old vision return as realized meaning.
The earlier dream supplies the remote temporal object now reaching fulfillment.
Correspondence with reality marks the return of the vision as verified completion.
Bringing others into presence expands the messenger's arrival into family-wide return.

structural_cues: 12:99-100 follow the restored sight with entry, embrace, elevation, prostration, and identification of an old vision's outcome.
The same arrival root used in the focus recurs for the family's being brought from the desert.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies local restoration, family entry and joining, and a dream declared real; I infer that the first return propagates across bodily, social, spatial, and temporal scales, while these may also be separate resolution beats rather than one recursive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports one man's recovered faculty before the family reunion.
changed_reading.after: The recovered faculty is a small-scale return that previews the return of persons, the closing of distance, and the arrival of an old vision at its real outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge in the focus is placed within a transmission chain: taught interpretation, news from what is absent to sight, and knowledge imparted secretly. The messenger and cure are the public end of a movement from hidden source to disclosed report to visible verification.

activation_trace.role: The news-bearing agent supplies the report's public carrier.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the focus claim's epistemic core.
Being taught locates comparable knowledge in reception rather than autonomous possession.
Reaching an outcome supplies the interpretive conversion from report to realized meaning.
A delivered report supplies the narrative form in which hidden knowledge travels.
Concealment from eyes defines the domain from which the report emerges.
Hidden imparting of knowledge supplies the directional channel from unseen source to knower.

structural_cues: 12:101 attributes interpretive knowledge to teaching, and 12:102 immediately classifies the narrative as unseen news communicated to the addressee.
The focus itself places knowledge 'from God' beside a messenger and an observable recovery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received knowledge, interpretation, unseen news, and hidden imparting; I infer one disclosure chain folding back onto the focus, while 12:102 may remain a narrator-level comment rather than specifying the focus speaker's mode of knowing.

changed_reading.before: The speaker claims a private God-derived certainty that the others lack.
changed_reading.after: The claim belongs to a mediated disclosure process: hidden knowledge is received, carried as news, and finally made publicly legible in restored sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recovered seer is set against a majority that does not settle into trust and against people who pass directly over visible signs while turning aside. The focus contrast is no longer only possession versus lack of information; it becomes receptivity versus practiced non-recognition.

activation_trace.role: Restored eye-sight supplies the embodied case of becoming able to see.
Inward discernment converts bodily seeing into a model of recognition.
Numerical predominance supplies the social scale on which non-recognition persists.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response that mere exposure fails to produce.
An outwardly available sign supplies what should be perceptible.
Passing across the sign supplies exposure without uptake.
Turning one's side away supplies the active orientation that blocks recognition.

structural_cues: 12:103-105 move from majority non-belief to repeated passage over signs while turned away.
The focus places recovered sight beside the explicit claim that the addressees do not know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, passage over them, aversion, and a majority lacking assent; I infer that the focus cure dramatizes receptive attention, while the later statements may generalize beyond this scene rather than interpret it directly.

changed_reading.before: One person regains sight and proves that his information was better.
changed_reading.after: The scene contrasts two perceptual postures: restored receptivity that recognizes a sign and socially dominant exposure that still turns away without knowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to speak, path, call, insight, and following turns the focus double sense of sight into a public orientation. Bodily recovery becomes an enacted precursor to a way consciously seen and communicable to followers.

activation_trace.role: Ocular seeing supplies the concrete starting pole of the lexical bridge.
Heart-sight supplies the latent second pole made explicit later.
The commanded utterance turns insight into public articulation.
A traversable way gives insight directional and practical form.
Calling by speech makes discernment socially transmissible.
Explicit inward insight confirms the non-ocular capacity latent in the focus adjective.
Following supplies the communal continuation of a way grounded in insight.

structural_cues: 12:108 repeats the focus sight root in an explicitly epistemic construction.
The repeated root is embedded in a sequence of saying, way, calling, and following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root echo and surrounds it with path and public call; I infer that the narrative restoration prefigures an epistemic stance, while the later insight may be an independent programmatic use of the root.

changed_reading.before: Inner sight is a plausible metaphor layered onto a literal cure.
changed_reading.after: The later explicit insight makes the cure a lexical hinge from recovered eyes to a consciously seen way that can be spoken, called toward, and followed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing pattern places rescuing arrival at the exhaustion of hope and opposes restored human capacity to divine force that cannot be driven back. The focus messenger's coming thus acquires threshold timing and an asymmetrical return structure.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the focus event that crosses the threshold into reversal.
Return to a prior state supplies gracious reversibility at the human level.
Hope's interruption supplies the terminal condition immediately before rescue.
The repeated arrival root links the focus messenger to the later advent of aid.
Aid and making manifest supply the rescuing content of the later arrival.
Repelling or blocking supplies the negative counterpart: divine force is not reversible.

structural_cues: 12:110 compresses despair, arrival, rescue, and non-repellability into one sequence.
The focus and 12:110 repeat both arrival and return roots with different grammatical valences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated arrival and return roots, with rescue after despair and force that cannot be repelled; I infer a threshold-and-asymmetry pattern, while the lexical recurrence may serve separate narrative and concluding functions.

changed_reading.before: The messenger happens to arrive at the point when sight is restored.
changed_reading.after: His arrival occupies a patterned threshold where exhausted expectation turns into aid: human loss can be reversed, while the enabling divine movement is not itself driven back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing frame asks the reader to track the narrated sequence and cross from one presented condition to another as a lesson. The focus face and eye remain literal, but their surface event becomes a disciplined passage toward inward discernment and guidance.

activation_trace.role: The visible front supplies the narrative surface from which interpretation begins.
Eye-sight preserves the event's irreducible bodily level.
Heart-sight supplies the inward level reached without canceling the bodily one.
Sequentially carrying a report makes the ordered focus details part of the interpretive mechanism.
Passage from one side to another supplies the movement from visible event to further meaning.
Making one condition instruct through another licenses the focus event as a retained lesson.
Gentle direction toward a way or truth supplies the endpoint of the interpretive crossing.

structural_cues: 12:111 explicitly frames the whole narrated sequence as a lesson for people of understanding.
The final frame preserves story, verification, detail, guidance, and mercy together rather than replacing the concrete events with an allegory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a final lesson-frame whose branch inventory includes crossing and analogy; I infer that it folds back onto the face-and-sight scene as a surface-to-discernment passage, while the final statement may authorize only a general lesson rather than this specific mapping.

changed_reading.before: The verse permits a bodily-versus-inward sight wordplay.
changed_reading.after: The closing lesson-frame turns that doubleness into an interpretive operation: retain the literal recovery, then cross through it toward disciplined recognition and guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary focus sense is return, whereas the packet's non-dominant mapped root contributes a stripped or denuded surface. It remains anchored in the exact focus root mapping and in the adjacent face-to-sight sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant material analogy for removal of an occluding layer, never as a replacement lexical gloss for the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb at word 8 stands between the face at word 7 and seeing at word 9.

activation_trace.role: Loss of an outer covering supplies an exploratory material image for renewed visibility.
The face as exposed surface gives the denuding image a local attachment.
Seeing supplies the outcome that makes removal of occlusion intelligible.

changed_reading.before: Sight simply returns to its former state.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the return can be pictured as the facial field being stripped of an occluding surface so that seeing reappears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The inversion is surprising because placing something over a face normally obstructs sight, and 12:107 supplies a later covering associated with unperceived arrival. It remains valid as a structural contrast because the focus explicitly orders over-face placement before seeing. Downstream prose should call this a cover/uncover paradox, not claim a lexical identity or specify the object's intrinsic power.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: What is cast over the face at words 5-7 is followed, counterintuitively, by becoming sighted at word 9.

activation_trace.role: Casting until an object lies upon another supplies the physical overlay.
The face supplies the normally visibility-sensitive surface being overlaid.
The resulting eye-sight reverses the expected effect of an overlay.
A later enveloping cover supplies the contrasting case in which covering threatens awareness.
Fine awareness supplies the perceptual capacity absent at the later covered arrival.

changed_reading.before: An applied object serves as the occasion for restored sight.
changed_reading.after: The scene stages a material paradox: one over-face covering unveils perception, against a later covering whose arrival finds people without awareness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the packet's non-dominant mapping from the saying root to a littleness root, then contrasts it with later numerical majority. It remains anchored in the repeated focus saying and the nearby claim that most do not believe. Downstream prose should mark it as form-distant wordplay about social weight, not as the lexical meaning of the focus verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speaker repeats the saying root in 'Did I not say to you' before contrasting his knowledge with theirs.

activation_trace.role: Littleness supplies the exploratory image of a socially discounted utterance.
Numerical abundance supplies the majority whose weight does not guarantee recognition.
Settled assent supplies what the many still fail to reach.

changed_reading.before: The rhetorical question recalls a prior statement now shown to be correct.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a saying treated as little outweighs the many: truth's epistemic force is detached from the number or social confidence of its hearers.

strongest_changes: Scent before sight revises the cure from first perception into public completion of a cross-sensory recognition.
The accusation of old deviation is reversed into demonstrated knowledge and then opens confession and repair.
The return of one faculty propagates into family reunion, dream fulfillment, and hidden knowledge becoming publicly legible.
Later signs, explicit insight, and the final lesson-frame turn restored eyesight into a model of receptive discernment without erasing the bodily cure.
The closing rescue pattern gives the messenger's arrival threshold timing and contrasts reversible human loss with force that cannot be repelled.
summary.what_was_special: The densest latent activation is simultaneously material and epistemic: news opens a surface, an object placed over a face yields rather than blocks sight, scent anticipates vision, and hidden knowledge acquires a public mark. These mechanisms support several coexisting readings rather than one disambiguated interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only pronoun does not identify the transferred object, so no retained model depends on naming it.
The packet supports the contact sequence but does not decide whether contact is efficient cause, sign, occasion, or narrative synchronization.
The later insight and lesson echoes may intentionally reread 12:96 or may operate as broader concluding frames.
The stripped-surface and little-versus-many readings depend on non-dominant mappings and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Face-brightening news arrives materially and reverses blindness.** ب ش ر B005 (face-brightening tidings), ل ق ي B005, و ج ه B001, ر د د B001 (returning), and ب ص ر B001 form arrival–contact–return. I infer that the messenger’s news and the shirt’s contact are one restorative event.
2. **Recovered sight verifies earlier asymmetric knowledge.** ع ل م B001 repeats 12:86 after sensory restoration. The ayah reads as convergence of inward knowledge and outward sight, without reducing one to the other.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:99-100 extended bodily restoration into social restoration; recovered sight preceded secure entry and the fulfilled dream scene.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Return realized as restoration to a former state.** `ر د د:B001` is returning to a prior place or condition, and its accepted scope explicitly includes restored sight. The messenger arrives, casts the shirt on the face, and *fa-irtadda baṣīran* follows; 12:94 had anticipated presence by scent, while 12:95 denied the knowledge claim. The packet supplies contact and restoration; I infer the shirt is the immediate enabling medium without claiming an unstated physiology. The verb reads as a precise bodily return that vindicates a prior epistemic stance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:100 says the first dream was made true, expanding restored sight into restored vision in the broader sense: Jacob can now witness the relation his earlier knowledge anticipated.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sabahın ilk ışıklarını, hurmanın ilk olgunlaşma belirtilerini, yağmuru haber veren rüzgârları ve bir şey tamamlanmadan beliren izleri tek bir erken görünme çekirdeğinde birleştirir. Bunlar sevindirici haberin kendisi değil, yaklaşan şeyin ön belirtileridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Erken belirti anlamı çeşitli biçim ve yapılarda gerçekleşir; sabah, hurma ve yağmur rüzgârı okumaları kendi yapılarının kapsamındadır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey tamamlanmadan önce beliren ilk görünüm, iz veya belirtileri anlatır. Sabahın ilk ışıkları, hurmanın ilk olgunlaşma renkleri ve yağmurun yaklaştığını bildiren rüzgârlar bu erken görünmenin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir süreç veya şey tamamlanmadan önce onun ilk görünür izleri ve başlangıçları belirir.
Sabahın gecede beliren ilk ışık yolları ve başlangıç anları bu kapsamdadır.
Hurmada olgunlaşmanın ilk renkleri ve ilk olgun ürünün görünmesi erken belirti sayılır.
Yağmuru getiren rüzgârlar, yaklaşan yağışın önceden beliren işareti olarak adlandırılır.
Rüzgârın, hayvan böğrünün veya sevinçli yüzün erken görünen izleri de aynı ilk belirti düşüncesine örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin ilk görünen başlangıçları ve tamamlanmadan önceki belirtileri olarak sunar; sabah ışığı, hurmanın ilk olgunluğu, yağmur rüzgârı ve çeşitli izleri bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تباشير الصبح وأوائل كل شيء وتباشير النخل وأول رطبه والرياح المبشرات بالغيث والطرائق أو الآثار التي تبدو قبل تمام الشيء.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مؤدم مبشر، أي الكامل الذي جمع لين الأدمة وخشونة البشرة أو جمع الفضيلتين الظاهرة والباطنة، ويقاس عليه المؤدمة المبشرة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما سمي لقوة من العقاب، والدلو اللقوة إذا أريد بها الاسم المذكور في باب العوج.
يدخل فيه وصف الناقة أو المرأة أو الحيوان بسرعة اللقح والحمل، والمثل لقوة صادفت قبيسا.
يدخل فيه اللقاء والملاقاة والتلاقي والتلقي بمعنى الاستقبال والمصادفة والحذاء، ومنه لقاء الخير أو الشر إذا صور مصادفة أو استقبال شيء.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden atma veya bırakma hareketini çekirdek yapar. Sevginin birine yöneltilmesi ve çözülecek bir sözün birine sunulması, aynı yöneltme yapısının bağımlı kullanımlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak atma eylemi ile sevgi yöneltme ve çözülecek söz sunma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar ayrı belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden atmak, bırakmak veya belirli bir alıcıya yöneltmektir. Sevgi yöneltme ve çözülmesi istenen bir sözü birine sunma, bu hareketin kalıplaşmış kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesne bulunduğu yerden atılır, fırlatılır veya bırakılır.
Atılan ya da aktarılan şey belirli bir kişiye veya onun üzerine yöneltilebilir.
Soyut kullanımlarda sevgi birine yöneltilir veya çözmesi için birine bilmece niteliğinde söz sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar atma ve bırakma hareketinde birleşir. Toplu claim, bu hareketin bir alıcıya yönelmesini, sevgi aktarımını ve çözülmesi istenen sözün sunulmasını da kapsar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ألقيته إذا طرحته أو نبذته، وإلقاء الشيء إلى غيره أو عليه، وإلقاء الألقية إذا طرحت عليه كلمة معاياة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اللقى والشيء الطريح والثوب أو الخرقة أو المنبوذ الذي يلقى لهوانه أو لا يعرف صاحبه.

branches.branch_image_ar: ما يلقاه المرء من خير أو شر
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه لقي فلان خيرا أو شرا، ورجل لقي شقي لا يزال يلقى شرا، والألاقي من عسر وشر.
يدخل فيه النهي عن التلقي إذا تلقى الحضري البدوي أو الركبان فاشترى منهم قبل معرفة السعر.
يدخل فيه الاستلقاء على القفا وكل انبطاح على الظهر أو نحوه.
يدخل فيه لا قيت بين شخصين أو بين طرفي قضيب حتى تلاقيا واجتمعا، وما يشبه الجمع والتحاذي بين طرفين.
يدخل فيه تلقي الكلام أو القرآن أو الكلمات بمعنى أخذها وتعلمها، وإلقاء الكلام أو القراءة بمعنى تلقينها.
يدخل فيه الملقى أو الملقاة إذا أريد بها أشراف نواحي الجبل أو ملتقى ما بين الجبلين، والملاقي شعب رأس الرحم أو مآزم الفرج.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin veya kişinin önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna dönmesi yahut bir etken tarafından oraya döndürülmesidir. Kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanılması da aynı geri gelme düzeninin özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Hareketin temel yönü, bir varlığın daha önce bulunduğu yere veya duruma geri gelmesidir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir etken, şeyi yerine, sahibine veya bağlı olduğu merciye geri gönderir.
Bir yetinin yeniden ortaya çıkması, önceki durumun geri kazanılması olarak kavranır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortaklaştırılmış anlatımı, kendiliğinden geri gelme ile bir şeyi geri gönderme biçimlerini tek dönüş çekirdeğinde birleştirir; yer, sahip, merci ve önceki işlev bu yönün farklı hedefleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna yöneldiği hem geçişsiz hem geçişli kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dönüş yönünü, önceki konumu veya durumu ve ettirgen geri gönderme seçeneğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Görme gibi kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanıldığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki durumun veya işlevin yeniden elde edilmesini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin sahibine veya ait olduğu yere gönderildiği geçişli bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi ait olduğu kişiye veya yere geri yöneltme ilişkisini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı, ayrılmanın ardından eski yere veya duruma geri gelmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın topluluk ve yer uzantıları odak dalın çekirdeğinde değildir; odak dalın ettirgen geri gönderme kapsamı da komşu kartta aynı açıklıkta bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yineleme, gidip gelme, kararsızlık ve sıkı yapılı olma anlamlarını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yineleme, aynı hareketin birden çok geri dönüş içermesi nedeniyle dönüş fikriyle bağlantılıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yönü önceki konuma çeviren tek olayı anlatabilir; komşu dalda ise tekrar, iki yön arasında hareket veya kararsızlık belirleyicidir.

branches.branch_image_ar: الرجوع إلى الشيء أو رده إلى موضعه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رجوع الشيء أو الشخص إلى موضع أو حالة سابقة، ورد الشيء إلى صاحبه أو إلى الله، وعودة البصر ونحوه
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد مطرد منقاس وهو رجع الشيء (maqayis)؛ رده إلى منزله ورد إليه جوابا أي رجع (sihah)؛ الرد مصدر رددت الشيء (tahdhib)؛ الرد صرف الشيء بذاته أو بحالة من أحواله وفارتد بصيرا أي عاد إليه البصر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yöneldiği taraftan çevirmeyi ve zarar, lütuf ya da ceza bağlamında onu savuşturup engellemeyi aynı uzaklaştırma işlevinde birleştirir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu yapıya bağlı anlamı doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yön, hedef veya engelleme ilişkisini açıkça kuran yapılarda geçerlidir; yalın köke genel bir engelleme anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yöneldiği yol, hedef veya eylemden çevirerek uzaklaştırmak; böylece bir etkiyi, zararı ya da sonucu savuşturmak veya engellemektir.

facets.statement: Etkilenen varlık, yöneldiği yol veya işten başka tarafa çevrilir.
Bir etki ya da sonucun gerçekleşmesine engel olmak, onu hedeften uzaklaştırmanın özel biçimidir.
Çevirme sert bir savma biçiminde olabileceği gibi bir işten yumuşakça vazgeçirme biçiminde de gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, yönünden çevirme ile bir etkiyi önleme arasında işlevsel bağ kurar; savma, engelleme ve bir işten vazgeçirme aynı yapı içindeki farklı şiddet dereceleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın yolundan çevrildiği veya bir etkinin hedefe ulaşmasının önlendiği bağlı yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yön değiştirmeyi, uzaklaştırmayı ve bunun engelleyici sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zarar, ceza veya başka bir etkinin hedefe ulaşmasının önlendiği bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir etkiyi hedeften uzak tutma ve gerçekleşmesini önleme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin yöneldiği işten çevrildiği, özellikle yumuşak yönlendirmenin söz konusu olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi yöneldiği işten başka yöne çevirme ilişkisini açık biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiyi bir işten yumuşakça çevirme ve engellenemez sonuç yapıları bu dala özgüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda belirleyici olan nesne, söz ya da paranın kabul edilmemesi veya yanlış sayılmasıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رد الشيء عن وجهه أو عن أمر، ودفع الضرر أو منعه، وما لا راد له بمعنى لا دافع ولا مانع
branches.source_phrase_ar: رده عن وجهه يرده ردا ومردا صرفه (sihah)؛ رده عن الأمر ولده أي صرفه عنه برفق (tahdhib)؛ لا راد لفضله أي لا دافع ولا مانع له وعذاب غير مردود (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رد الشيء إذا لم يقبل، وتخطئة القول، ورد الدراهم الزائفة على ناقدها

يدخل فيه رجوع المرء من الإسلام إلى الكفر، والردة اسما لذلك، والمرتد
يدخل فيه المردودة من النساء، وهي المطلقة الراجعة إلى أهلها أو أبيها ولا كاسب لها
يدخل فيه الشاة أو الناقة إذا أضرعت أو امتلأ ضرعها، وكثرة الماء أو الموج، واجتماع ماء الرجل بطول العزبة
يدخل فيه الردة في الوجه أو الذقن، والقبح مع شيء من جمال، والرداءة، وحبسة اللسان

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir varlığın üzerindeki doğal örtünün bulunmaması veya giderilmesi ortaklığını açıkça destekler. Ancak dal için yapraksızlık ile kabuğun soyulması birlikte aktarılırken bir kaynak dalı bu sıfatla nitelemeyi reddeder; bu nedenle dal örneği genel çekirdeğin tartışmasız bir uygulaması olarak sunulmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel örtüsüzlük veya örtüyü giderme çekirdeğini verir; yapraksız dal, sakalsız genç, tüysüz at ve bitkisiz arazi okumaları yalnız kendi ad öbeklerine bağlı uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde doğal olarak bulunan saç, kıl, tüy, yaprak, kabuk veya bitki örtüsünün hiç bulunmaması ya da üzerinden giderilmesidir. İnsan, hayvan, bitki ve araziye göre yok olan örtünün türü değişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın üstünü doğal olarak kaplayan unsurun bulunmaması veya giderilmesi anlamın ortak çekirdeğidir.
İnsan ve at gibi canlılarda sakalın, kılın veya belirli bir bölgedeki tüyün bulunmamasını anlatır.
Ağaç ve dal bağlamında yaprak ya da kabuk gibi üzerini örten unsurun yokluğunu veya giderilmesini anlatır.
Kumluk ve arazi bağlamında bitki yetişmemesini ve yüzeyin bitki örtüsünden yoksun kalmasını anlatır.
Dalın bu sıfatla nitelenmesi kaynaklarda aynı ölçüde kabul edilmez; bu kullanım ihtiyatla değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı saç, kıl, yaprak, kabuk veya bitki gibi doğal bir örtünün yokluğudur. Dalın adlandırılmasında bir kabul ayrılığı bulunsa da ağaç, genç, at ve bitkisiz kumluk örnekleri bu ortak alanı somutlaştırır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تجرد الغصن والشجر من الورق أو اللحاء، وخلو الرمل أو الأرض من النبات، وخلو الخد أو البدن أو الفرس من الشعر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: تجريد الشيء من قشره أو ما يعلوه من شعره؛ شجرة مرداء وغصن أمرد ورملة مرداء وغلام أمرد وفرس أمرد (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ الرمال المرداء التي لا تنبت شجرة والأمرد الذي لم تنبت له لحية (ayn)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تمليس البناء وتطيينه وصقله، والصرح أو البناء الممرد الطويل الأملس.
يدخل فيه المارد والمريد من شياطين الإنس والجن، والتمرد والعتو والاستعصاء، والمرون أو الجران على النفاق أو الشر.
يدخل فيه مرد الخبز أو الطعام إذا ماثه حتى يلين، والمريد من التمر المنقوع في اللبن، ومرد الصبي ثدي أمه، وما يجاور ذلك من الثريد.
يدخل فيه المرد بمعنى حمل الأراك أو ثمر الأراك الغض، في مقابل النضيج الذي يسمى الكباث.
يدخل فيه دفع الملاح السفينة بالمردي، وهي خشبة يدفع بها السفينة.
يدخل فيه التمراد: بيت صغير يجعل في بيت الحمام لمبيضه، وجمعه التماريد إذا نسقت بعضا فوق بعض.
يدخل فيه المراد بالفتح إذا أريد به العنق، مع التنبيه إلى تردد بعض المصدر في صحة القياس.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gözle görmeyi, görme duyusunu, bakan organı, kör olmayan kişiyi, dikkatle bakışı ve yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesini birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dalın ana kimliği bedensel görme alanıdır; kalp bilgisi veya delil anlamları bu dala taşınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak görme duyusunu temel alır, fakat dikkatle bakma ve yavrunun göz açması gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı bağlı uzantılar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gözle görme alanı: görme duyusu, bakan göz organı, bir şeyi gözle görmek ve gözün görmeye açılması. Dikkatle dikilerek bakma veya yavrunun gözünün açılması gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
Görme yetisine sahip kişi kör olanın karşıtı olarak adlandırılır.
Dikkatle ve keskin biçimde bakma, görme çekirdeğine bağlı kalıplaşmış bir kullanımdır.
Yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesi de görme alanına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi bu dalı bedensel görmeye bağlar: göz organı, görme duyusu, gözle görme eylemi ve görme yetisi olan kişi. Aynı toplu iddia ayrıca yoğun bakış kalıbını ve yavrunun gözünün açılmasını çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Göz duyusu, göz organı ve gözle görme eylemini birlikte karşılayan en kısa doğal ifadedir.

Bir işte veya dinde bilinçli, kavrayış sahibi ve sağlam kanaatli olma özel bir kullanımdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما العلم بالشيء وبصرت بالشيء إذا صرت به بصيرا عالما والبصيرة البرهان (maqayis)؛ البصر نفاذ في القلب والبصيرة اسم لما اعتقد في القلب من الدين وحقيق الأمر واستبصر في أمره ودينه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ حسن البصيرة إذا كان مستبصرا في دينه (jamhara)؛ البصر العلم وبصرت بالشيء علمته والتبصر التأمل والتعرف والبصيرة الحجة والاستبصار في الشيء (sihah)؛ لقوة القلب المدركة بصيرة وبصر وعلى معرفة وتحقق (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يوصف بأنه مبصر بمعنى مضيء أو بين أو مبصر به أو جاعل للناس بصراء، والتبصرة بمعنى التبيين.
يدخل فيه البصيرة من الدم: القطعة أو الطريقة أو المقدار على الأرض أو الجسد، وما اتصل بها من ثأر أو دية في الشعر.
يدخل فيه البصيرة بمعنى الترس أو الدرع وكل ما لبس من السلاح إذا سمي بصائر.
يدخل فيه غلظ الشيء وجلده أو جانبه وحرفه، وخياطة أديم إلى أديم أو ما بين شقتي البيت أو الثوب أو المزادة، والقطعة الملفقة.
يدخل فيه البصرة والبصر بمعنى الحجارة الرخوة أو البراقة أو المائلة إلى البياض، والأرض المسماة بذلك، ومنه تسمية البصرة والإتيان إليها.

Dallar eş adlı ve kısmen imgesel bağlantılar taşısa da her biri kendi madde, eylem veya kavrayış alanında sınırlandırılmalıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المقول بمعنى اللسان.
يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.
يدخل فيه القول بمعنى الاعتقاد، نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة.
يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.
يدخل فيه استعمال المنطقيين القول بمعنى الحد، كقول الجوهر وقول العرض أي حدهما.
يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.
